title: Bastion Labs appoints former Meridian Cloud executive Dana Okafor as CEO
author: Sofia Brennan
text:
Bastion Labs appoints Dana Okafor, a former Meridian Cloud executive, as CEO, the AI security startup said on Monday, as it prepares to sell its model-protection software to larger enterprises.

Okafor spent nine years at Meridian Cloud, most recently running its security and identity business, which she grew to more than $900 million in annual sales. She replaces co-founder Felix Grant, who will become Bastion's chief technology officer.

Bastion Labs makes software that scans AI models for tampering, monitors them for data leakage and controls which users and applications can query them. The company says its customer count tripled over the past year, to about 140.

"AI security is moving from the research team to the boardroom," Okafor said. "Bastion has the technology. My job is to help customers buy it with confidence."

Grant said the change had been planned since the company's last investment round. "I want to spend my time on the product, and Dana has scaled exactly the kind of business we want to become," he said. Bastion Labs is backed by Northgate Ventures.
